core_obligations: Set up the factorization: choose a polynomial ring over the source mapping onto the middle ring and generators of the target over it, giving a square of finite type homomorphisms and a surjection onto the target (proof lines 4782-4793)

Base change the shriek: the base change statement for the surjection produces an arrow from the tensor of the shriek with the extended polynomial ring to the shriek of the base changed complex, an isomorphism on bounded below complexes (proof lines 4794-4796)

Compose and cancel: adjointness to restriction identifies the shriek of the composite surjection with the composite of shrieks, and the double base change statement turns the composite of the two shrieks into the shriek of the composite, which is the asserted transformation (proof lines 4797-4812)
proof_roadmap: 取多项式环 P = A[x_1,...,x_n] 与满射 P → B，再取 C 在 B 上的生成元得 Q = P[y]，记 Q' = Q ⊗_P B，χ: Q' → C。
由 flat-bc-surjection：ψ^!(M) ⊗_B^L Q' → (ψ')^!(M ⊗_P^L Q)，在 M 有下界时为同构。
由与限制函子伴随：χ^! ∘ (ψ')^! = (χ ∘ ψ')^!；代入 K 的分解并用 double-base-change，得到 b^! a^!(K) → (b∘a)^!(K) 的同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a transformation b^! o a^! -> (b o a)^! for finite type homomorphisms A -> B -> C of Noetherian rings and asserts that it is an isomorphism on bounded below complexes (author lemma at source lines 4774-4779, label lemma-composition-shriek-algebraic). The proof (source lines 4781-4813) factors the situation through a polynomial ring over A mapping onto B together with a presentation of C over it, applies the base change statement for the surjection onto that presentation, uses adjointness to restriction to identify the shriek of the composite surjection, and closes the displayed chain of identifications with the double base change statement (proof lines 4800-4812). The factorization and the chain of identifications are the substance. H3.
